# sailpoint_managed_cluster (Data Source)

Data source for a SailPoint managed cluster (virtual appliance cluster). Look up a cluster by `id` or by `name`. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be provided. Typical use: feed `id` into `sailpoint_source.cluster` instead of hardcoding it. Key material (key pair, keystore, public keys) is deliberately not exposed, so it never lands in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a managed cluster (virtual appliance cluster) by name.
data "sailpoint_managed_cluster" "by_name" {
  name = "Example Cluster"
}

# Or by ID.
data "sailpoint_managed_cluster" "by_id" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_CLUSTER_ID"
}

# Typical use: reference the cluster from a source instead of hardcoding its ID.
# resource "sailpoint_source" "example" {
#   ...
#   cluster = {
#     type = "CLUSTER"
#     id   = data.sailpoint_managed_cluster.by_name.id
#   }
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the managed cluster. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) The managed cluster name (exact, case-sensitive match). Use as a lookup key (mutually exclusive with `id`) or read the resolved name after lookup by `id`. Returns an error if zero or several clusters match.

### Read-Only

- `alert_key` (String) Key describing any immediate cluster alert (for example `LIMITED_RESOURCES`).
- `ccg_version` (String) The CCG version used by the cluster.
- `client_ids` (List of String) IDs of the clients (virtual appliances) in the cluster.
- `client_type` (String) The type of client in the cluster (for example `CCG` or `VA`).
- `configuration` (Map of String) The cluster configuration map (for example `gmtOffset`, `clusterType`).
- `consolidated_health_indicators_status` (String) The consolidated health status: `NORMAL`, `WARNING` or `ERROR`.
- `created_at` (String) When the cluster was created.
- `current_installed_release_version` (String) The release currently installed on the cluster.
- `description` (String) The description of the managed cluster.
- `operational` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is operational.
- `org` (String) The tenant (org) the cluster belongs to.
- `pinned_config` (Boolean) Whether the cluster configuration is pinned.
- `pod` (String) The SailPoint pod hosting the cluster.
- `service_count` (Number) Number of services bound to the cluster.
- `status` (String) The cluster status: `CONFIGURING`, `FAILED`, `NO_CLIENTS`, `NORMAL` or `WARNING`.
- `type` (String) The cluster type (for example `idn` or `iai`).
- `updated_at` (String) When the cluster was last updated.
